featured_techniques.technique: Make belief a competency across the organization
Trust-based messaging to customers and service partners
Belief as a driver of loyalty and growth

summary: In this brief message, Jeanne Bliss argues that belief is not a mere feeling but a strategic driver of business performance. By declaring belief in customers and those who serve them, companies channel decisions and actions toward trust, imagination, and growth. Bliss contends that the most successful organizations treat belief as a core competency spanning people and operations, and at critical decision points they suspend cynicism and fear to let belief guide outcomes. The result, she suggests, is enhanced loyalty from customers and employees and stronger overall business growth.
title: Decide To Believe (Decision 1) — Belief as a Business Competency
topics: suspension of cynicism at decision points
suspension of fear at decision points
